attchmntText: Zodiac Clothing Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Zodiac Clothing Company Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The results were published in Business Standard and Lokmat on 7th November 2026. Prakash Gold Palace Private Limited issued an invitation for expression of interest under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code. The last date for receipt of expressions of interest is 23rd November 2026. The provisional list of prospective resolution applicants is scheduled for issue on 3rd December 2026. The final list of applicants will be issued on 18th December 2026. The request for resolution plans will be issued on 23rd December 2026. The last date for submission of resolution plans is 22nd January 2027.

desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32

attchmntText: Zodiac Clothing Company Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
